messages:
ana: Quick sync on a few prompt-sets & evals UX items: inline score editing, staged approvals, diff heatmap contrast, and keyboard-only comment composer. Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 50-55) :mag:
kevin: Inline score edit idea: click score chip -> small popover numeric stepper (0-5). Save on blur. Avoid full modal for quick tweaks.
maria: Love it. Two asks: 1) show why change (history snippet) 2) confirmation for org-level changes that affect weightings.
jun: For history snippet, show last 3 edits in the popover with timestamp and actor. Make each entry a link to the audit log.
tom: Accessibility: popover must trap focus while open and be reachable via keyboard (enter/space on chip). On close, focus returns to chip. Also SR should announce "Editing score" when opened.
eva-bot: Visual check: heatmap low-contrast at 10% opacity fails AA in both light/dark. Recommend using stronger saturation or patterned overlay for colorblind users.
maria: For heatmap, can we add optional matrix legend and hatching pattern for users with color vision issues? Toggle in settings.
eva-bot: Contrast+pattern suggestion logged as ticket RG-heat-307.
kevin: Staged approvals: instead of instant-approve, stage items to a sidebar queue where reviewers can bulk-finalize. This reduces accidental approvals. Small teams can opt-out in workspace settings.
nana: (not in thread) +1 to staged as default for multi-reviewer workflows.
maria: Microcopy: change CTA from `Approve` -> `Stage for approval` when staging, and `Finalize approvals` when completing. Include count and an estimated time for async finalize jobs.
jun: Keyboard-only comment composer: add a single-line quick composer that expands with Ctrl+Enter to full composer. Must be accessible from row via `c` shortcut.
tom: Composer a11y: ensure ARIA label, visible focus ring, and that multiline expansion maintains SR context. Also support Escape to collapse/close and Ctrl+Enter to submit.
kevin: Also allow inline attachments via paste; show accessible filename and remove option.
maria: Scorecard: add a "weight" quick-edit next to each criterion (tiny pencil icon). Changing weight should show a small warning if it affects previously scored examples.
jun: When weight changes, surface a modal: `Changing weight affects X scored examples. Proceed?` with `Preview impact` link that shows before/after aggregated scores.
ana: Good. For the preview, show delta heatmap and a numeric summary. Keep it lightweight.
eva-bot: Regression detected: keyboard nav test rs-inline-021 failing when composer expands — focus gets lost. Ticket created.
kevin: I'll take rs-inline-021. Likely need to manage focus after expansion and set aria-activedescendant for composer. ETA tomorrow morning.
maria: Small copy nit: table header currently says "Examples". PMs prefer "Examples (preview)" to emphasize these are samples, not the full dataset.
tom: A11y checklist to add to QA: 1) popover edit trap & announce 2) composer expand/collapse focus 3) staged sidebar reachable and SR-readable 4) heatmap legend accessible 5) keyboard shortcuts documented.
jun: I'll update the keyboard shortcuts modal and add `?` help overlay entry for comment composer.
ana: Thanks all. Quick thumbs if you agree: inline score popover, staged-as-default with opt-out, keyboard composer with expand, heatmap pattern toggle. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup:
jun: :thumbsup:
ana: closing after PRs/tickets linked.
